interpretation: This hosted runner has one observed UDP endpoint on port53. It is inadmissible for the proposed exclusive owned-port53 experiment. No endpoint was cleared, stopped, changed or taken over, and the port pair was not replayed.
next: Stop the owned-port53 mechanism on this runner; no takeover or automatic retry. Any different mechanism requires a separately reviewed plan.
privacy: Only capped count, fixed status, process exit/cleanup booleans and public CI/code metadata. No endpoint address, owning PID, raw error or credentials.
